productPrinciple: Normal Q&A/Tips surfaces retain knowledge only when it is useful for the current supported DDV version/platform context. Wand is not a historical knowledge archive.

questionResolution.solvedRequirement: At least one reusable resolution record must exist.

solutionNote.purpose: Record self-resolution or a synthesized resolution so later readers can understand how the issue was solved.

invalidOrNonProblem.note: Do not mark these SOLVED merely to close them.

freshness.current: Believed useful/applicable for the current supported DDV version/platform context.
freshness.needsRecheck: Temporary uncertainty after a relevant DDV update/system change or conflicting evidence; excluded from normal current/recommended surfaces until revalidated.

onConfirmedOutdated.tip: Delete from normal knowledge storage/public surfaces.
onConfirmedOutdated.answer: Delete the outdated answer. If the question itself remains current and has no other current solution, return the question to UNRESOLVED.
onConfirmedOutdated.question: Delete the whole question/thread when the problem itself is no longer applicable to the current supported DDV state.

freshness.retentionException: Only minimal structural/audit/moderation records may remain when required by moderation, security, legal hold, or deletion-ledger contracts; obsolete knowledge payload is not kept for ordinary history.

mayUse: author verification on the current supported DDV version/platform
credible Worked / Does Not Work feedback
update-diff evidence linked to affected systems/entities
